items.title: 5.12 Bernoulli ke usool ke istemalat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.12 with Figs. 5.17 to 5.23 (PDF 109-112).

blocks.text: Bohat se aale us dabao ke farq se kaam karte hain jo fluid ki speed ki tabdeeliyon se paida hota hai.
Hawai jahaz ke par

Par yun banaya jata hai ke hawa ko mor de taake streamlines par ke oopar neeche ke muqable zyada qareeb hon. Jahan streamlines zyada qareeb majboor hon wahan speed tez hai, to hawa par ke oopar neeche se tez chalti hai; par ki choti par dabao kam hai, par oopar ki taraf dhakela jata hai, aur hawai jahaz ka lift isi asar se hai. (Par bahar gol aur andar chapte kyun hain? Muri oopar ki satah rasta lamba karti aur par ke oopar streamlines jama karti hai.)

blocks.alt: Hawai jahaz ke pichhle hisse ka pehloo se manzar, aage par (wing) ka section. Baen se aati sabz streamlines par ki muri hui oopri satah par bohat qareeb jama hoti hain aur neeche phaili rehti hain, sab daen taraf chalti hain. Par ke neeche surkh teer oopar ki taraf hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.17: Hawai jahaz ki lift (kitab ki Figure 5.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jahan streamlines qareeb hain wahan hawa tez hai aur dabao kam. Par ke oopar hawa tez (dabao kam) aur neeche aahista (dabao zyada) hai; neeche ka zyada dabao (surkh teer) par ko oopar dhakelta hai: yahi lift hai.
Gend ka swing

Jab gend ko spin ke saath phenka ya thokar mari jaye to bowler gend ko ek taraf se zyada hamwar banata hai aur doosri taraf khurdari rehti hai. Hawa khurdare hisse par tez chalti hai aur hamwar par sust; Bernoulli ki equation se tez chalti hawa kam dabao banati hai jabke sust hawa zyada dabao, aur yeh dabao ka farq ek tarfa force, Magnus effect, paida karta hai jo gend ko hawa mein morta hai.

blocks.alt: Hawa ki dhaar mein gend, hawa daen se baen chalti hai. Gend ke oopar streamlines qareeb (Faster air, lower pressure), neeche phaili hui (Slower air, higher pressure). Deflection force ka teer gend se oopar hai. Chhoti tasveer (Spinning ball) mein ghoomti gend ka rasta dashed seedhi lakeer se oopar mur jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.18: Turbulent flow (ghoomti gend ke gird hawa ka bahao) (kitab ki Figure 5.18 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab is tasveer ka caption 'Turbulent flow' likhti hai, lekin tasveer ghoomti gend ka swing (Magnus effect) dikhati hai. Gend ke oopar hawa tez aur dabao kam, neeche hawa aahista aur dabao zyada hai; is farq se force gend ko oopar (kam dabao ki taraf) morti hai.
Filter pump

Filter pump ke darmiyan tangi hoti hai, to nal se pani ka jet wahan tez bahta hai. Is se us ke qareeb dabao girta hai aur hawa is liye side tube se andar aati hai; hawa aur pani mil kar pump ke neeche ke hisse se bahar nikalte hain.

blocks.alt: Filter pump ka andaruni khaaka. Pani oopar ki tube (Water) se aata hai aur tang nozzle se tez dhaar ban kar pump ke jism mein neeche jata aur neeche ke munh se nikalta hai. Daen taraf side tube (Air flow) par teer hawa ko dhaar ki taraf andar aata dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.19: Turbulent flow (filter pump) (kitab ki Figure 5.19 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Carburetor

Car engine ka carburetor cylinders ko hawa aur petrol ka sahih mixture dene ko Venturi duct istemal karta hai. Hawa duct se aur ek pipe ke saath cylinders tak kheenchi jati hai, aur duct ke kinare ek nanha inlet petrol se bhara jata hai. Duct se hawa bohat tez chalti hai, duct mein kam dabao banati hui, jo petrol ke bukharat hawa ki dhaar mein kheenchta hai.

blocks.alt: Khara Venturi duct jis mein oopar se Air dakhil hoti hai. Duct tang gale (throat) tak sukarta hai, jahan neeche ki taraf teeron wali streamlines qareeb aa jati hain, aur phir neeche chaura ho jata hai. Gale par Low pressure likha hai. Baen taraf Gas ka khana, Atmospheric pressure par, ek muri pipe se gale se jura hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.20: Engine ka carburetor (kitab ki Figure 5.20 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Gale (throat) mein hawa tez hai is liye dabao kam hai. Petrol (gas) ke khane par bahar ki hawa ka (atmospheric) dabao hai, jo zyada hai; yahi farq petrol ko pipe se gale mein dhakel kar hawa mein mila deta hai.
Paint sprayer

Liquid mein doobi tube par se guzarti hawa ki dhaar liquid ko tube mein oopar uthati hai. Yeh asar perfume ki botlon aur paint sprayers mein istemal hota hai: jab atomizer ki rubber ki gend dabai jati hai to hawa tube se guzar kar tang munh se tez speed se nikalti hai, dabao ki kami paida karti hui, to hawa ka dabao perfume ko oopar tang munh tak dhakelta hai.

blocks.alt: Neela teer Air ko ek line mein dakhil hota dikhata hai jo daen taraf Nozzle tak tang hoti hai. Nozzle se ek khari tube surkh Paint ke bartan mein doobi hai; surkh teer paint ko tube mein oopar uthta aur nozzle se phuhaar (spray) bante dikhate hain. Neele teer bartan ke andar paint ki satah par neeche dabate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.21: Liquid mein doobi tube ke oopar se guzarti hawa ki dhaar (kitab ki Figure 5.21 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Nozzle par hawa bohat tez hai, is liye tube ke oopar dabao kam ho jata hai. Paint ki satah par hawa ka dabao (neele teer) zyada hai; yahi dabao paint ko tube mein oopar dhakelta hai. Paint 'khincha' nahi jata, dhakela jata hai.
Venturi relation

Ek pipe lein jis mein density rho ka fluid cross-section ke mukhtalif raqbon se bahta hai (Fig. 5.22): chaure sire par A1 aur tang hisse par A2, flow speeds v1 aur v2 aur dabao P1 aur P2 ke saath jo manometer ki shakhein batati hain. Chunke pipe ufqi hai, ausat potential energy dono jagah ek si hai, to Bernoulli ki equation deti hai P1 + (1/2) rho v1^2 = P2 + (1/2) rho v2^2, ya P1 - P2 = (1/2) rho v2^2 - (1/2) rho v1^2, ya P1 - P2 = (1/2) rho (v2^2 - v1^2) ... (5.25). Equation of continuity se A1 v1 = A2 v2, v1 = A2 v2 / A1. Chunke A2, A1 ke muqable chhota hai, v1, v2 ke muqable chhoti hai: chaure hisse mein fluid tang hisse ke muqable bohat sust hai, to Eq. 5.25 ke daen hisse mein v1 nazar andaz ki ja sakti hai: P1 - P2 = (1/2) rho v2^2 ... (5.26). Yeh Venturi relation hai, jo Venturi meter mein istemal hoti hai, liquid ke bahao ki speed napne ka aala. Ufqi pipe ke liye Bernoulli ki equation se saaf hai ke jahan speed zyada ho wahan dabao kam hoga: P + (1/2) rho v^2 = mustaqil (Interesting Information).

blocks.alt: Ufqi pipe: baen taraf chaura hissa A1, beech mein tang gala A2 aur daen phir chaura. Teen streamlines gale se guzarte hue qareeb aa jati hain; chaure hisse mein v1 aur gale mein v2. Neeche U-tube manometer chaure hisse aur gale ko jorta hai: chaure hisse ke neeche satah P1 neechi hai aur gale ke neeche satah P2 us se h oonchi.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.22: Venturi meter (kitab ki Figure 5.22 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chaure hisse mein dabao P1 zyada hai, is liye woh manometer ke maye (liquid) ko apni taraf zyada neeche dabata hai; gale mein speed zyada aur dabao P2 kam hai, is liye wahan satah h oonchi hai. P1 - P2 = (1/2) rho v2^2.
Torricelli ka theorem

Bernoulli ki equation ka saada istemal: farz karein fluid ke bare tank mein do chhote soorakh A aur B hain (Fig. 5.23). Soorakh A se pani nikalne ki speed nikalne ko: chunke soorakh bohat chhote hain, nikalne ki speeds v2 aur v3 pani ki oopar ki satah ki speed v1 se bohat bari hain, to v1 taqreeban sifr li ja sakti hai. Bernoulli ki equation phir P1 + rho g h1 = P2 + (1/2) rho v2^2 + rho g h2 hai; magar P1 = P2 = hawa ka dabao, to v2 = sqrt(2 g (h1 - h2)) ... (5.27). Yeh Torricelli ka theorem hai: nikalne (efflux) ki speed us velocity ke barabar hai jo fluid gravity ke tahat faasla (h1 - h2) girne mein hasil kare. Nikalne ki speed oonchai (h1 - h2) se girti gend ki speed jaisi hai: tank ki oopar ki satah thori neeche hui aur PE nikalne wale fluid ki KE mein muntaqil hui. Agar soorakh B par oopar ki taraf hota (print 'Fig. 6.4' ka hawala deta hai, jo is chapter mein nahi) to yeh KE liquid ko tank ke pani ki satah tak uthne deti; amal mein viscous-energy nuqsan nateeje ko kuch had tak badalte hain.

blocks.alt: Pani ki oonchi tanki, jis ki satah speed v1 se neeche aati hai aur tah se oonchai h1 par hai. Daen taraf surakh A, tah se oonchai h2 par aur satah se h1 - h2 neeche, se speed v2 ki dhaar mur kar neeche girti hai. Baen taraf neeche surakh B se tube dhaar ko oopar morti hai (speed v3) aur pani tanki ki satah ki oonchai tak uthta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.23: Surakh wali fluid ki tanki (kitab ki Figure 5.23 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Surakh A se nikalne ki speed v2 = square root of 2g(h1 - h2), jaise koi gend (h1 - h2) oonchai se gire. Surakh B ki dhaar oopar mori jaye to yahi KE use tanki ki satah tak utha deti hai. Kitab ka text is ke liye 'Fig. 6.4' likhta hai; sahih hawala Fig. 5.23 hai.

blocks.caption: Aale aur Bernoulli asar
rows: petrol ke bukharat hawa ki dhaar mein
P1 - P2 = (1/2) rho v2^2 speed napta hai

blocks.prompt: Tank mein pani ki satah se 5 m neeche soorakh hai; nikalne ki speed nikalein (numerical 5.7). Tez chalti train ke qareeb khara hona khatarnak kyun hai, aur venturi mask kaise kaam karta hai (short question 5.9; MCQ 5.11)?
blocks.explanation: v = sqrt(2 g h) = sqrt(2 x 9.8 x 5) = 9.9 m s^-1. Train ke saath ghaseeti hawa tez chalti hai, to us ka dabao aap ke peechhe ki sakin hawa se kam hai, aur dabao ka farq aap ko train ki taraf dhakelta hai. Venturi mask mein tang jet se guzarti oxygen tez chal kar dabao ghatati hai, kamre ki hawa ka muqarrar hissa kheenchti hui: Bernoulli ka usool.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Tez fluid, kam dabao: par ka lift (oopar streamlines qareeb), ghoomti gend ka swing (Magnus effect), filter pump, carburetor (Venturi duct), paint sprayer aur atomizer.
Venturi: ufqi pipe, P1 - P2 = (1/2) rho (v2^2 - v1^2), v1 na-qabil-e-zikr ho to P1 - P2 = (1/2) rho v2^2 (Venturi meter). Torricelli: v2 = sqrt(2 g (h1 - h2)), gehrai se free-fall ki speed.
